# lcd.isVisible

<div class="api-badges"><span class="api-badge api-badge--since">since 1.5.0</span></div>

Check if the window is visible on screen or not.

```lua
local visible = lcd.isVisible()
```

## Parameters

None.

## Returns

visible (boolean)

## Examples

```lua title="From the official Ethos documentation"
lcd.isVisible()
```
